methodology: Deep angles NOT covered in R1-R3: multi-step workflows, state machines, error recovery, concurrent admins, TypeScript type safety, API contract mismatches, edge-case data, CSS/layout, responsive, performance, cross-platform journeys (frontend+backend), auth/security deep dive. Read ALL 64 frontend files + 15 backend route/middleware files.

critical_findings.summary: Monolithic component with 100+ useState. ANY state change re-renders entire app. Single largest perf bottleneck.

high_findings.summary: No retry button for most tabs after API failure — must wait for poll cycle
Token expiry during long form fill destroys ALL unsaved state — no recovery
Pervasive 'as any' on JSON parse results hides missing fields (ai.ts, health.ts, barcodeSheets.ts)
Unsafe 'return data as T' generic cast in analytics getJson — no runtime validation
Unsafe cast after .json().catch(() => ({})) — empty object cast to typed interface (grnAlerts.ts, staff.ts)
refundAmount ambiguous: paise or rupees? Frontend divides by 100 but field name has no Minor suffix
Inconsistent pagination response shapes across API modules (data+pagination vs flat)
getInvoice returns json.data which could be undefined — caller accesses .invoiceNumber
AuditStatsResponse has count:string should be number — string concat risk ('5'+'3'='53')
AIInsightsTab runJob clears data error then succeeds — previous fetch error silently lost
QualityDashboardTab Promise.all partial failure loses BOTH datasets
Audit log CSV export only exports current page (50 records) — no indication to user
AnalyticsTab 8 sub-tabs with data tables — no virtualization, hundreds of DOM rows
RegistrationsTab 9-column table unreadable on tablet/mobile
GrnAlertsTab 10-column table overflows on anything under 1200px
InvoicesTab 10-column table no responsive handling
Toast notifications only in App.tsx — tabs use inconsistent inline banners
Frontend declares void invoice status but no backend void endpoint exists
Store suspension shows no cascading impact preview (devices, staff, orders, invoices)
Store suspension does NOT deactivate devices or revoke POS tokens

GstComplianceTab detail error overwrites overview error

MonitoringTab auto-refresh races with slow API — overlapping requests
QualityDashboardTab same auto-refresh race condition
formatCurrency masks null/undefined as Rs 0.00 instead of dash
3 duplicate formatCurrency definitions with inconsistent decimal places
ApplicationsTab businessName no CSS truncation for long strings
GrnAlertsTab store_id.slice crashes on undefined/null

StoresTab credit limit NaN.toLocaleString when value is NaN
sa-grid-2/3/4 hardcoded columns — no responsive breakpoints
Z-index conflict between modal systems (all at z:1000, approval at z:9999)
References to nonexistent CSS classes btnSm, btn
SuppliersTab verified 8-col table no responsive breakpoint
MonitoringTab sa-grid-3/4 no responsive breakpoints
DocumentsTab modal minWidth:400 overflows mobile screens
UsersTab client-side filter runs in render body — not memoized
PaymentsTab all events in memory — no server-side pagination
SuppliersTab useEffect resets state on every pendingProducts reference change
EventsTab, PaymentsTab use plain Loading text — no skeleton
AnalyticsTab 8 sub-tabs with no skeleton loading
MonitoringTab, QualityTab, CreditProviders plain Loading text
3 different error banner CSS patterns across tabs
2 separate confirmation dialog systems with different visual treatment
No Request More Documents action for applications
No supplier-portal activity visibility in superadmin
No unpublish/deactivate product endpoint — published products cannot be hidden
